snippet.title: Bony Odyssey Teaser
snippet.description:
A fast-paced 2D platformer packed with action and endless challenges!

You are a Skeleton, and your beloved animals have vanished! Dash, jump, and zip through a world full of danger, secrets, and non-stop surprises. Navigate treacherous traps, battle relentless foes, and uncover the mysteries hidden within this dark yet charming adventure.
